summary: Recent updates to the OpenGL and GL contexts in Firefox enhance how the browser interacts with graphics hardware, particularly using EGL and ANGLE technologies, which help improve rendering performance across different platforms. Notably, the implementation of **CreateContextFlags::HIGH_POWER** allows browsers to leverage higher power settings for better graphics performance on capable devices, ensuring a smoother experience while running graphically intensive content. Additionally, various improvements like refactoring how EGL displays are created and enhancing the capabilities of IOSurfaces with GLBlitHelper make the graphics pipeline more efficient and compatible, ultimately resulting in better visual quality and responsiveness for users across different operating systems.
